comments.body: Also, take a look at the Robotic Systems Lab (RSL). They are focussing on bringing quadrupeds into more and more complex environments, such as e.g. densely vegetated areas. Never heard of something in the direction of Archaeology, but they are currently also going toward planetary exploration. Maybe you could also go into that direction and work on analysis software for e.g. the Lunar surface?
comments.author: Papierkor654
